name: Saelis Moonthorn
source_profile: ● Saelis Moonthorn (CG) is a wandering pathfinder, who considers isolation irresponsible. She has secretly guided refugees, displaced elves, and even a few desperate Cadorian settlers through Hollowbough territory.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 65 (source excerpt; may be partial)
